2608.05391.title: Adaptive Arena-based Contestable Argumentative Network-of-Experts for Open-Ended Care Plan Coordination
2608.05391.paper_summary: Care plan coordination demands synthesizing heterogeneous clinical, functional, and psychosocial information across multiple professional disciplines, where monolithic LLM pipelines cannot perform in a transparent or safe manner. We present CANOE (Contestable Argumentative Network-of-Experts), a multi-agent neuro-symbolic framework that addresses these limitations through five modules: complexity assessment, adaptive team recruitment, role-based argumentative computation via an Arena-based Quantitative Bipolar Argumentation Framework (A-QBAF), human-in-the-loop contestation, and care-plan synthesis. Role-specialized agents generate supporting and attacking arguments for candidate interventions; conflicts are resolved through arena-based clash resolution before acceptability scores propagate across the argumentation graph. Care planners may accept, reject, edit, or add arguments, and the framework will deterministically recompute the final plan. Evaluation on Discharge Me! and MedicalRAG using ROUGE-L, AlignScore, MEDCON F1, FKGL, and LLM-as-a-judge shows that medically fine-tuned models achieve the strongest clinical correctness and safety, while CANOE's argumentative structure provides faithful explanation and human contestability.
2608.05391.paper_summary_zh: 照護計畫的協調需要整合來自多個專業領域的異質臨床、功能和心理社會信息，而單一的 LLM 管道無法以透明或安全的方式執行。我們提出了 CANOE（可爭辯的專家網絡），這是一個多代理神經符號框架，通過五個模塊解決這些限制：複雜性評估、適應性團隊招募、基於角色的爭辯計算，通過基於競技場的定量雙極爭辯框架（A-QBAF）、人類參與的爭辯和照護計畫綜合。專門角色的代理生成支持和攻擊候選介入的論點；在可接受性分數在爭辯圖中傳播之前，衝突通過基於競技場的衝突解決來解決。照護計畫制定者可以接受、拒絕、編輯或添加論點，框架將確定性地重新計算最終計畫。在 Discharge Me! 和 MedicalRAG 上使用 ROUGE-L、AlignScore、MEDCON F1、FKGL 和 LLM 作為評判的評估顯示，醫療微調的模型達到了最強的臨床正確性和安全性，而 CANOE 的爭辯結構提供了真實的解釋和人類的可爭辯性。
